title: Gold Years Account at a glance
summary: The “Gold Years Account” is for customers aged 62+ and includes a $0.00 monthly maintenance fee, 1.0% APY on checking, free paper statements ($0.00/month), and 3 complimentary personal check orders per year. It also offers up to 2 days early direct deposit, $5,000/day mobile check deposits, $0.00 out-of-network ATM withdrawal fees, a 12.5% partner pharmacy prescription discount (debit card required), a $50 one-time Social Security direct deposit bonus, a 17.5% estate planning consultation discount, and linked savings APY boosts (Gold Plus +0.5%, Silver +0.6%).
